title: feat(ui): the timeline's Changes chip holds the audit's field changes only; the CRM opens field history on its four main objects
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBVmFoQ6NLiPf5VfPaWXaynQ)_

Fixes #30074
Supersedes #30158

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 记录动态里的「变更」只放审计日志读出的字段变更（带旧值→新值）；「创建了 / 更新了 / 删除了 / 分配了 / 共享了」这类活动事件一律归「活动」，不论对象是否开启字段历史。面板下拉的「字段变更」用同一规则。另保留 #30158 的裁决 A 部分：CRM 示例四个主对象开启 `enable.trackHistory`，未开启历史的对象不显示「变更」筛选。
- **为什么改：** 按裁决 C（6649643659，维护者原话 「C」），它细化裁决 A（6631104393）：分类由记录本身的来源决定，不随开关变；没开历史时「变更」本就无内容，隐藏它名副其实。
- **风险与回滚：** 风险低：只改前端筛选规则与示例标志，不改数据、接口、spec，也没动 `ACTIVITY_TYPE_TO_FEED_TYPE` 映射表；回滚即撤销本 PR。注意：在非默认记录页上（自取 `sys_activity` 的面板），下拉选「字段变更」今后为空，因为那里不读审计（见 Acceptance notes）。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/recordTimelineStream.ts`（新判定 `isFieldHistoryEntry` 与 `filterTimelineStream`）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`（面板 `changes_only` 同规则）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`（翻转的「四个筛选」pin 与新 pin）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`，预期全部通过；或 `pnpm dev:crm` 后新建一条线索并改公司名，打开动态页签：「变更」里是「公司 旧 → 新」，「活动」里是「创建了 线索…」。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

Resumed from `claude/issue-30074-crm-track-history@8c5b89c9` (draft PR #30158, option A as built), merged with `origin/main` at `9b8a5867`, then the ruling C delta on top.

- **Ruling C, the stream.** New `isFieldHistoryEntry(item)` in `recordTimelineStream.ts`: an item is a field-history entry when it is a `field_change` read from the audit log (`source: 'sys_audit_log'`, which `auditEntriesToFeedItems` stamps). `filterTimelineStream` uses it: Changes holds those only, Activity holds everything that is neither a comment nor one of those. The `sys_activity` rows that share the `field_change` presentation (`created`, `updated`, `deleted`, `assigned`, `shared`) are therefore Activity, whatever the history flag. `ACTIVITY_TYPE_TO_FEED_TYPE` is not edited.
- **Ruling C, the panel.** `RecordActivityTimeline`'s `changes_only` dropdown filter uses the same predicate, so the panel and the stream agree on what a change is.
- **Kept from #30158 (ruling A):** the CRM example's `crm_lead`, `crm_account`, `crm_contact`, `crm_opportunity` declare `enable: { trackHistory: true }`; `RecordFieldHistoryContext` plus `timelineStreamFilters()` hide the Changes chip while the record shows no field history, a stream left on Changes falls back to All, and `RecordDetailView` hands over its `historyEnabled`.
- Changeset `.changeset/30074-crm-track-history.md` (from #30158) amended to ruling C (patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`); plugin-detail README says what Changes holds.

File surface: #30158's 13 files plus two existing plugin-detail test files whose pins read the old classification (`renderers/__tests__/record-activity.test.tsx`, `renderers/__tests__/recordChatterFilterModeMentions-8968.test.tsx`); see Tests. No server, REST or spec change.

## Tests

All readings on head `93bbdd78`, the final commit.

- **Flipped pin** ("the four chips", `recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`): the activity `created` row now sits under Activity, Changes holds the audit change alone, and every entry lands under exactly one of Activity / Discussion / Changes.
- **New pins** (same file, top-level describe): with history on AND off, Activity lists every one of the five activity events and no audit change; CONTROL with history on, Changes holds the field change with its old and new values and none of the events; the panel's `changes_only` keeps the same rule as the stream.
- **Fixture triage, two existing files.** `record-activity.test.tsx`: its "filterMode seeds which slice" pin seeded `changes_only` and expected the activity `updated` row, which ruling C moves out; it now seeds `tasks_only` (still proves the seed), and a new pin asserts `changes_only` holds no activity event. `recordChatterFilterModeMentions-8968.test.tsx`: its field-change fixture row gains `source: 'sys_audit_log'`, the stamp of the one producer of `fieldChanges` in the tree (`auditEntriesToFeedItems`); its assertions are unchanged.
- **Ablation** via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `recordTimelineStream.ts`, anchor `item.type === 'field_change' && item.source === 'sys_audit_log'` replaced by `item.type === 'field_change'` (the subject resolves to `src` through the `ui/vitest.config.mts` aliases, so no dist leg): anchor 1 to 0, blob `16c475ce1d79` to `aee54ae67d0a`; 6 tests red, exactly the flipped and new pins; the 8968 file green (its row is a real field change either way). Restored: blob equals HEAD `16c475ce1d79`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Live** (example CRM, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, Vite console, zh-CN): a new `crm_lead` (history on) edited once through the data API: chips 全部 / 活动 / 讨论 / 变更; 变更 shows 「公司 Ruling C Ltd → Ruling C Holdings」 and the creation's field values; 活动 shows 「创建了 线索 "Live Check Lead"」 only. A new `crm_activity` (history off) edited once: chips 全部 / 活动 / 讨论, no 变更; 活动 shows 「更新了 活动 …：主题」 and 「创建了 活动 …」. On the history-on lead the `updated` activity row steps aside because the audit says the same update with values (`mergeTimelineStream`, unchanged).

<details><summary>Test readings</summary>

- Targeted, the three touched test files: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 69 passed (69), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail` whole package plus the app-shell pin file `RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678.test.tsx`: Test Files 370 passed, 1 skipped (371); Tests 3292 passed, 18 skipped (3310).
- Type-check: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` exit 0; `@object-ui/app-shell` exit 0 after the full build (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). A first app-shell run before the full build failed on unbuilt `@object-ui/*` declarations (TS2307), not on this diff.
- Ablation run: Test Files 2 failed, 1 passed (3); Tests 6 failed, 63 passed (69); restore proven as above.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The panel's `changes_only` off the default record page.** Off the synthesized record page the `record:activity` panel holds `sys_activity` rows only and reads no audit, so under ruling C its 字段变更 slice is empty there; before, it listed the activity `created` / `updated` rows. This follows the ruling's "same rule for the panel" and is pinned; whether that panel should offer the option at all where no audit is read is left to the seat.
- **Bears on #30122 (not folded).** On a history-on lead created through the data API, 全部 says the creation twice: the activity row 「创建了 线索…」 and an audit entry listing each initial value (「负责人 — → Dev Admin; 线索名称 — → …」). `auditEntriesToFeedItems` keeps any audit entry with changes, the create entry included, although its doc says the creation is the activity stream's own row. Under ruling C the audit half sits under 变更 and the activity half under 活动. Compact rows did name the actor in this run (「· Dev Admin · 刚刚」).
- `main` moved 14 commits after the merge at `9b8a5867`; none touches a path in this diff (`git diff --name-only HEAD...origin/main` against the 15 paths: zero hits) and `git merge-tree` is clean, so the branch was not re-merged. CI runs the merge ref.
- Screenshots: kept in the project files, not committed.

## Verification

Gates from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, derived at `93bbdd78` (53 commands).

<details><summary>Gate readings</summary>

- 53 of 53 run serially after a full build, each exit code captured before any pipe: all 53 exit 0. `--ran`: "53 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 53 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 170 passed, 2 skipped (172); Tests 4985 passed, 2 skipped.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- `check-platform-checklist` not owed: no export renamed or removed (`isFieldHistoryEntry` is added to the module, not to the package entry).
- Not run locally, CI's: Build Core, Type Check UI and the workspace type-check lanes, Test Core, Test UI (whole app-shell), the repo-wide lint.

</details>
